When the first and second round matches were finished as draws, their winners were decided on the regular season rankings without extra time and penalty shoot-outs. The winners of the second round and the runners-up competed with the tenth and eleven-placed team of the [[2022 K League 1|K League 1]], respectively, in the final round for the K League 1 spots of the next season.
